The obvious fix is /login, but running it returns:

"/login isn't available over Remote Control."

So the only recovery is to physically walk to the host machine or SSH in and re-auth there, which defeats the entire point of remote access. Logging out and back in on the mobile app does nothing because the token lives on the host.
